{{Quote|I have yet to visit Ashas Ree, but various Sith texts stress that it is an insignificant world. Tragically, many once prominent Sith worlds&mdash;including Ziost, Khar Delba, and Khar Shian&mdash;went the way of Ashas Ree, as all were largely stripped of their relics by Republic forces after the Great Hyperspace War.|Seviss Vaa, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Ashas Ree''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ashas Ree system/Legends|Ashas Ree system]], located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. It was situated deep within the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], in which it was considered a lesser world.

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Garu]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] and lost the [[Holocron of King Adas]] on Ashas Ree during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. [[4400 BBY|Six hundred years later]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Freedon Nadd]] rediscovered the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], using its knowledge to [[Coup on Onderon|subjugate]] the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] launched an [[Battle of Ashas Ree|attack]] on Ashas Ree that was repelled by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] under the command of the Sith Lords [[Darth Angral]] and [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Rim Campaign]] of the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I command a line of siege tanks positioned to hold off the Republic's armored floaters that regularly prod our defenses along the jungle border.|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />}}
Ashas Ree was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> of the [[Ashas Ree system/Legends|eponymous]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was a part of the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> situated in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay along the [[Kamat Aegit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the planets [[Kalsunor]] and [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]], while the [[Zorfe Trete]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked Ashas Ree to the world of [[Ch'hodos]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet's surface featured [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] and rock formations.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|Around the time of the Great Hyperspace War, a Sith Lord named Garu lost King Adas's Holocron on the planet Ashas Ree, where it remained until it was found centuries later by Freedon Nadd. Other sources suggest that Freedon Nadd's search for Sith knowledge led him to Yavin 4, where he apprenticed with the spirit of Naga Sadow.|Tionne Solusar, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="jvs" />}}
[[File:Freedon_Nadd_Headshot.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Freedon Nadd (pictured) rediscovered the Holocron of King Adas on Ashas Ree.]]
A battle-scarred world,<ref name="TEA" /> Ashas Ree was located deep within the territory of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ashas Ree system/Legends|Ashas Ree system]]</ref> and held the status of one of the empire's lesser worlds. Thereby, it was under the control of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the Sith Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="jvs" /> during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|326|Garu, Lord}}</ref> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Garu]], who was the holder of the [[Holocron of King Adas]], [[Death/Legends|perished]] on Ashas Ree, thus leaving the [[Sith holocron/Legends|ancient relic]] behind where it remained undiscovered for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="END" />

In [[4985 BBY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] member [[Seelah Korsin]] believed that the [[Statue of Yaru Korsin|statue]] of her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], the [[Grand Lord]] [[Yaru Korsin]], in the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] was so ill-made that it would taint even the killing fields of Ashas Ree.<ref name="paragon" /> In [[4400 BBY]],<ref name="jvs" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Freedon Nadd]] journeyed to<ref name="NAD4">{{FactFile|90|NAD 1-4|The Shadow of Freedon Nadd}}</ref> the planet<ref name="END" />&mdash;once part of the Sith Empire&mdash;after he [[Duel on Ossus|slayed]] his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Matta Tremayne]].<ref name="NAD4" /> There, Nadd rediscovered [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]]'s [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which he used to acquire knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] for his successful bid to [[Coup on Onderon|subjugate]] the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="END" />

===The Sith resurgent===
{{Quote|We must now defend the heart of our own territory. I am enraged the Dark Council allowed the war to reach Ashas Ree, yet I must allow some measure of admiration for the way the Republic has outmaneuvered us.|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />}}
[[File:JournalOfDarthMalgusAshasReePage-BookOfSith.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Malgus mentioned Ashas Ree in his personal war journal (pictured).]]
Around [[3660 BBY]], during the [[Rim Campaign]] of the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by Jedi Master [[Ven Zallow]] launched an [[Battle of Ashas Ree|attack]] on Ashas, but it was successfully repelled by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under the command of the Sith Lords [[Darth Angral]] and [[Darth Malgus]]. In the Battle of Ashas Ree, Malgus commanded a line of [[Imperial crawler tank|Sith siege tanks]] that were positioned to hold off [[Armor/Legends|armored]] Republic [[Landspeeder/Legends|floaters]] along the jungle border, with the Imperials being protected by an [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shield]] projected above them. At one point during the battle, Malgus recorded the events of the engagement in his personal [[Journal of Darth Malgus|war journal]], which he kept throughout the Rim Campaign.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a Republic [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droid]] impersonated a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] on Ashas Ree. It was eventually taken into custody and its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] was secured before the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] could delete the data.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|The Automated Saboteur}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] member [[Seviss Vaa]] researched the worlds of the Sith Empire and mentioned in his writings that various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] texts had deemed Ashas Ree an "insignificant" world and that he had yet to visit it. In his recordings in the [[Telos Holocron]], Vaa also claimed that the world had largely been stripped of its [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith treasures]] by Republic [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] following the end of the Great Hyperspace War.<ref name="jvs" />

===Commentary by Palpatine===
{{Quote|Regarding Seviss Vaa's descriptions of the worlds in Sith space, I can only assume he either lied about his visits to Khar Delba and Khar Shian or that his powers of observation were sorely lacking, as I recovered valuable relics on both worlds.|Palpatine, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="jvs" />}}
[[File:Telosholocron.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Ashas Ree was mentioned in the Telos Holocron (pictured).]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] discovered several pages of Malgus's journal and provided them to his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], as a teaching material. Sidious and Vader both heavily annotated Malgus's account of the Battle of Ashas Ree before Sidious added the pages to his religious compendium, the ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /> 

At some point between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine made an addendum to Vaa's Telos Holocron recordings, disputing his claims, as he had recovered valuable relics on the planet [[Khar Delba]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Khar Shian]]. The contents of the holocron were later published in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] as part of the compendium ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]'' that was composed by the Jedi Master [[Tionne Solusar]].<ref name="jvs" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|We arrived just in time to halt their advance on the central garrison. Do they think they can hold this world? Do they hope to fortify it as a staging point for a strike against Dromund Kaas?|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />}}
Ashas Ree hosted the [[Central garrison (Ashas Ree)|central garrison]] of the reconstituted Sith Empire around 3660 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|I write from a clearing at the garrison's outskirts, amid the encampments of the planet's doctrinists, who desire a return to the Empire's isolationism. They have often stood in opposition to our Emperor&mdash;but today, we are all Sith.|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />}}
Ashas Ree was the site of [[doctrinist]] encampments around 3660 BBY,<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /> as well as killing fields by 4985 BBY.<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ashas Ree was first mentioned in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 90|ninetieth]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] magazine ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'',<ref name="NAD4" /> which was published around [[September 17]], [[2003]].<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|90}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was mentioned in a Scavenging Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. Initially the mission was restricted to Sith Empire&ndash;aligned player characters, though both that restriction and the information regarding the mission's outcome were later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" /> It was first pictured in [[2012]]'s ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and illustrated by [[Jeffery Carlisle]].<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />
